body: Commit 508159c (+ CHANGELOG). Replaced the free-toggle armor-stack W with a real cast: untargetable+rooted for 1.5s (intangible_ms/rooted_ms, same combo the R already uses), then a one-shot AoE eruption on resurfacing via a new dedicated mnm_burrow_ms countdown. Gated all 3 auto-attack loops + the legacy 1v1 resolve_combat resolver so a burrowed MnM can't still swing -- a real gap the test-writing process itself caught. 11 new/updated tests, full suite green.
title: MnM W rework -- Burrow (S170-208)
